company.shortDescription: Airtable is a cloud-based work management platform that combines databases, workflows, automations, and AI tools in a shared workspace.
company.description: Airtable is a cloud-based work management platform that combines databases, workflows, automations, and AI tools in a shared workspace. It enables teams to build custom applications, manage projects, organize data, automate processes, and collaborate across functions. The platform also integrates with third-party business applications and supports AI-powered workflows, data analysis, and record management.

aiResearchSummary.text: Airtable is researching systems for managing and manipulating data within server environments, as seen in 'Database with integrated generative ai,' which integrates generative AI fields for natural language requests. 'Record templates' focuses on templates for creating data objects with dynamically calculated fields. 'Constructing and enforcing access control policies' addresses user and element permissions. Other areas include automatic data type detection, partial table synchronization, and email-based data transfer and synchronization.
